notes: Labeled "Sonnet 5.6 (next)" by the repo owner, who believes requests for claude-sonnet-5-5 were being routed to a newer model at the time. Every run in the session reported claude-sonnet-5-5 as the executed model. Before the prompt, the same session answered one short no-tools question the repo owner uses to check which model is answering. The prompt was written by an orchestrating Claude Opus 5.5 session that only prompted; all code is the Sonnet session's own. It was sent as one message, with the output folder filled in and an opening line saying the check had passed. It also allowed the agent to read and adapt the capture plumbing (not the visuals) from an earlier project's cap.mjs and finish.sh, and said the RTX 5090 was shared with another agent session rendering at the same time. prompt.md leaves those out. There were no follow-up messages: the session's later turns were wake-ups from its own background renders finishing. Other agent sessions shared the GPU and CPU for the whole run.
